stem: A science class designed five studies to test whether background music affects how quickly people solve puzzles. The table shows whether each study selected its participants at random from a population and whether it assigned the treatments (music or no music) at random. For how many of the five studies can a cause-and-effect conclusion be drawn about the participants in that study?
solution: A cause-and-effect conclusion requires random assignment of treatments; random selection is not needed for a conclusion about the participants themselves.
Studies II, III and V assigned treatments at random.
verify:
n = sum(1 for row in figure['rows'] if row[2] == 'Yes')
assert n == 3
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [n]
